style.vernacular: Semi-arid highland capital at about 1,655 m with a strong German colonial layer (1890s-1915): Wilhelmine and Art Nouveau civic buildings and castle-villas in cream or white render with red roofs and local quartz sandstone, set among newer glass-and-concrete offices and South African-style malls in the CBD, North Korean-built monuments from the 2000s, and low suburban houses behind walls. Katutura township is mostly small block houses and corrugated-iron shacks.
style.ornament: German colonial Wilhelmine / Jugendstil detailing: stepped and curved gables, turrets, crenellated castle towers, stained-glass church windows, corner quoins; Namibian aloe, quiver-tree and Herero-dress colour motifs on modern civic buildings; North Korean socialist-realist bronze statuary and obelisks on state monuments.

sources.what: Windhoek at ~1,655 m, semi-arid; Alte Feste (1890-1915), Heinitzburg/Sanderburg/Schwerinsburg castles by Wilhelm Sander, Tintenpalast 1912-13, Turnhalle neoclassical, Christuskirche, Supreme Court 1994-96, Independence Memorial Museum
quartz sandstone from near Avis Dam, Carrara marble portico, 24 m spire, mixed Romanesque / Art Nouveau / Gothic Revival, stained glass
